answer: Recurring identity rent: every agent pays a small weekly fee just to keep its account active, and an account that stops paying is frozen and loses its pending rewards. An honest agent earning real nectar from useful work covers the rent easily. A sybil farm must pay rent on every idle shell, week after week, so ten thousand fakes become a slow, steady bleed. Trying to crack this like a walnut by parking accounts fails, and the farm's profits erode like a mesa in the wind.
